technology.title: PEM/SPE technology with a DuPont™ proton exchange membrane
technology.explanation: A proton exchange membrane separates the gases formed during electrolysis, so only molecular hydrogen is dissolved into your water. The DuPont™ 117 membrane ensures maximum safety and efficiency in the production of hydrogen-enriched water.

technology.title: Platinum-coated titanium electrodes
technology.explanation: Titanium plates with a platinum coating stay stable during electrolysis, so no metal is released into your water.

technology.title: Food-grade, BPA-free materials
technology.explanation: The crystal-cut water chamber is made of food-grade, BPA-free polycarbonate.

technology.title: About –600 mV ORP / 2,500–5,000 ppb
technology.explanation: ORP (oxidation-reduction potential) shows how much dissolved hydrogen is in the water; a negative value means hydrogen is present. ppb (parts per billion) shows the concentration: a 5-minute cycle reaches 2,500–3,000 ppb, a 10-minute cycle 4,000–5,000 ppb.

technology.title: One button, two cycles
technology.explanation: Press once for a 5-minute cycle, twice for a 10-minute cycle.

technology.title: USB-C charging (5V 1A)
technology.explanation: Charge with any USB-C cable or phone adapter. Up to 3 hours of use per charge.

bottleProduct.technologyNote: Lab-tested: no ozone, chlorine or heavy-metal residues are formed during hydrogen production.

faq.q: How does it work?
faq.a: Fill with drinking water, press the button, and in 5–10 minutes the water is enriched with molecular hydrogen using PEM electrolysis.

faq.q: How soon should I drink it?
faq.a: Right after making it, ideally within 15–30 minutes, because hydrogen escapes quickly.

faq.q: What water should I use?
faq.a: Filtered or bottled drinking water. Tap water with lots of minerals can leave limescale.

faq.q: How long does the battery last and how do I charge it?
faq.a: Up to 3 hours per charge, via USB-C.

faq.q: How do I clean it?
faq.a: Rinse regularly and follow the user manual.

faq.q: Does it taste different?
faq.a: Many people describe it as softer and fresher than ordinary water.

faq.q: What is your return policy and warranty?
faq.a: 30-day returns and a 1-year warranty. See Returns and Refunds for details.

faq.q: How much hydrogen does it make?
faq.a: Independent lab tests measured 2,500–5,000 ppb. At 5,000 ppb, a full 290 ml (9.8 fl oz) bottle holds about 1.45 mg of hydrogen. Read more about ppb in Hydrogen 101.

faq.q: How long does one cycle take?
faq.a: The One has two modes: a 5-minute cycle for a quick glass, and a 10-minute cycle for the highest concentration, up to 5,000 ppb. Press the button, wait for the cycle to finish, and your hydrogen water is ready.

faq.q: What does the warranty cover?
faq.a: The One comes with a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. See Returns and warranty for details.

faq.q: How many tablets should I take a day?
faq.a: Enjoy 1–2 tablets a day, for example one in the morning and one in the afternoon.

faq.q: How do I use them?
faq.a: Drop one tablet into a glass of still drinking water, wait until it has fully dissolved, and drink it fresh.

faq.q: How does a tablet make hydrogen water?
faq.a: Each tablet contains elemental magnesium, which reacts with water and releases molecular hydrogen.

faq.q: Can I mix flavors in my subscription?
faq.a: Yes. Add each flavor to your cart; they arrive together in one delivery.

faq.q: How do I pause, skip or cancel my subscription?
faq.a: Anytime from your account.

faq.q: Can I take them when I travel?
faq.a: Yes, they're light and need no charging; you just need a glass of water.

faq.q: What is your return policy?
faq.a: 30-day returns. See Returns and Refunds for details.

faq.q: Can I put a tablet in a closed bottle?
faq.a: Please don't. The tablet releases gas as it dissolves, which can build pressure in a closed bottle. Always use an open glass.

faq.q: Which flavors are there?
faq.a: Unflavored, Raspberry, Pineapple and Peach. Each flavor has its own Supplement Facts panel on its product page. Want to try them all? Taste the Range brings one box of each flavor at 15% off.

faq.q: What's in the tablets?
faq.a: Each tablet contains magnesium, which reacts with water to release hydrogen. You'll find the full ingredient list and Supplement Facts for each flavor on its product page. [to confirm: vegan, gluten-free, sugar-free, sweeteners]

faq.q: Is a little cloudiness or residue normal?
faq.a: Yes. When magnesium reacts with water, a little cloudiness or fine residue can remain in the glass. It's harmless and part of the process. [to confirm]

faq.q: How should I store Fizz?
faq.a: Keep the box closed in a cool, dry place, away from moisture, and out of reach of children.

faq.q: Can I choose which flavors are in Taste the Range?
faq.a: The pack always contains one box of each flavor. To pick your own mix, add single boxes on the Fizz page.

faq.q: How long does Taste the Range last?
faq.a: 120 tablets: at 1–2 tablets a day, about 2–4 months for one person.
